name: China Hi-Tech Group Co., Ltd.
summary: China Hi-Tech Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates within the higher education sector across China. Its portfolio includes prominent institutions such as Peking University, Renmin University of China, and Fudan University. Beyond managing these academic establishments, the company also develops and offers accredited vocational education programs, comprehensive career training initiatives, and promotes international educational partnerships. Furthermore, it delivers a range of related services, including human capital development, support for innovative and entrepreneurial ventures, specialized personnel training, and expert educational consulting. The company also provides financial and leasing solutions specifically for the education industry. Founded in 1992, it is headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
